prompts.promptText: Reject the second candidate too. It is a close-up and cannot be accepted. Generate exactly ONE NEW full-canvas iPhone 11 Glitter Gel product image using the SAME FOUR attachments in the immediately preceding generation request, not either generated candidate. Absolute output contract: use IMAGE 1's entire original canvas and full case, from complete top edge through complete bottom edge, straight-on and uncropped. Preserve IMAGE 1 pixel-for-pixel for all bare-shell and hardware geometry. This is specifically iPhone 11: its two camera lenses MUST be vertically stacked on one straight vertical axis inside the original upper-left rounded-square camera island. Preserve the original flash and sensor locations. A diagonal two-camera layout is an automatic failure. Do not invent a newer iPhone, change lens count, change camera island, move buttons, change proportions, add a logo, or zoom/crop. Apply exactly ONE continuous pale pearly-white Glitter gel slab only in the usable back area defined by IMAGE 4: red is a strict no-gel camera keep-out. Use the continuous calm L-shaped coverage language in IMAGE 2, adapted to the iPhone 11 guide. The camera boundary must be one broad smooth rounded shoulder around the complete guide, never a tight lens trace or separate pieces. Maintain only a thin even bare-shell hairline at the outer edge. Use IMAGE 3 only for subtle translucent milky pearl micro-shimmer: ultra-fine, quiet, embedded sparkle; no dense sandy texture, sequins, flakes, crystals, blobs, marble, text, or shadows. Remove all red from final. Output only the complete finished iPhone 11 back-view product image.
